reserves.name: Staked Frax USD deployed strategy positions
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Frax Benchmark Yield Strategy and governance-approved strategy venues

reserveReview.rationale: Frax documents sfrxUSD as an ERC-4626-like token fully redeemable for frxUSD and states that the Benchmark Yield Strategy allocates staked frxUSD among carry-trade, DeFi AMO, and short-dated Treasury venues. The live adapter reports the full balance as deployed strategy positions, so the row retains the frxUSD wrapper dependency while classifying the immediate exposure as a protocol position across Frax-approved venues.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The frxUSD dependency and Benchmark Yield Strategy failure domain are identified at 100%, but the current venue and allocation among carry-trade, DeFi AMO, and Treasury strategies are not published.

providers.name: Frax-approved AMO, DeFi, carry-trade, and Treasury venues

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Frax identifies the vault and governance-approved strategy venues but does not establish legal segregation, bankruptcy remoteness, rehypothecation, or current venue shares.
